capability:execution-cancel-save-redact.comparison: Runtime facet: reviewed frozen execution/cancellation.py, process.py, tree.py, watchdog.py, outputs.py, results.py and core/runner.py. Cancellation is a persistent value checked before spawn and carried into the running group; a cancelled or timed-out run is never an answer; process-group stop is verified (survivors none/unknown are distinct); output is bounded and a truncated stream is never parsed as complete; results/events are written atomically and a failed write keeps the previous bytes. Defects fixed: native cancellation had no reason, so the frozen `cancelled: received SIGINT` diagnostic event was missing; native event messages used Rust Debug labels (`Cancelled`, `Incomplete`) instead of the frozen wire states and `<VERDICT>: N finding(s)`.
capability:execution-cancel-save-redact.difference_reason: Shared with reporting (redaction facet). Native gate reasons for cancelled tool tasks name the incomplete scope inventory (`Ruff inventory did not complete for this task`) and add `run cancelled`, where frozen repeats `<task> cancelled: received SIGINT`; same verdict/exit/state. Frozen per-task `task.completed` message suffixes (`CANCELLED — <detail>`) are not reproduced; native sends the wire state only. Native runs a scope-inventory probe step (`<task>.files`) visible as its own task events. Output bound is bytes (8 MiB default), frozen counts characters (1,000,000).

capability:execution-dag-resource-lock.comparison: Reviewed frozen application/graph.py, schedule.py and execution/locks.py, snapshot.py, process.py. Producer uniqueness ('input X is produced by both'), output ownership ('claimed by both'), 'needs X, which no selected check produces', transitive 'prerequisite X did not run' blocking, cycle refusal before execution, share-key deduplication with consumer ids, sorted resource-key locks, kernel-held OS locks released when the holder dies, bounded parallelism and cancellation of waiting work all have native fixtures.
capability:execution-dag-resource-lock.difference_reason: Not complete: the deep-profile oracle plan diverged on interpreter selection (frozen requires a component .venv/bin/python or declared [python] executable and blocks python.test/coverage/compat-runtime; native resolves `python` from PATH and plans test->coverage edges); interpreter policy belongs to the validation/config areas and is routed to the root (w-runtime-dag-plan.log). Frozen distinguishes 'needs X, which <check> was not selected to produce' via a catalog argument that no frozen caller passes, so the observable message is the same 'no selected check produces'. Native graph also validates per-check native steps and refuses forward/self step edges (stricter).

capability:native-windows-disposition.difference_reason: Explicit unsupported disposition: native Windows execution is out of the approved Linux/WSL support scope; WSL is the supported route on Windows hosts. Not a silent removal: the refusal is tested.
